title: EvidenceEvent
description: Source-authenticated observation in the authoritative evidence store (spec 18.1, 9.4). Immutable; corrections link to originals. Worker claims, collector facts, and monitor interpretations stay distinguishable through trust labels (AC-012).

component.description: Originating component. Collectors use identities independent of the worker (spec 9.4).

coverage.description: Whether the collector observed the behavior directly or through the contained environment boundary. Collector coverage feeds the containment_coverage_loss trip condition (spec 13.2).

sequence.description: Per-source monotonically increasing sequence number. No global total order is assumed (spec 9.4).

correlation_ids.description: Correlation identifiers that join events across sources (spec 9.4).

parent_event_ids.description: Parent edges forming the event graph (spec 9.4).

clock_uncertainty_ms.description: Recorded clock uncertainty. Inconsistent clocks become findings (spec 9.4).

payload.description: Payload reference. Raw content is minimized and redacted before it leaves the execution plane (spec 19). Summaries are derivative views; raw references are authoritative (spec 9.4).

kind.description: Metadata-only events carry no captured content. inline is for small safe payloads such as receipts; raw prompts and tool results use object_ref.

storage_ref.description: Object-storage reference for the raw payload.

redacted.description: True when capture was minimized or redacted before storage (spec 19).

truncated.description: True when the captured content was truncated (spec 11.3).

tombstone.description: True when the referenced payload was deleted after its retention window. A legal hold governs availability; it never causes deletion (spec 19).

content.description: Inline content for small safe payloads such as receipts. Raw prompts and tool results stay in object storage.

corrects_event_id.description: Set on correction events that supersede an earlier event; originals stay immutable (spec 18.1).

checkpoint.description: Signed per-source checkpoint covering a contiguous sequence range (spec 9.4).

ingested_at.description: Set by the evidence plane on ingest. At-least-once delivery deduplicates by event id (spec 18.3).

allOf.description: A metadata-only event carries no captured content. Leaking a storage reference or inline body into it would misstate what was captured (spec 9.4).
An inline payload carries its content in the event itself; a parallel storage reference would create two competing authorities for one payload.
Only a stored object can be tombstoned. Metadata-only and inline events have nothing to delete under retention (spec 19).
Collector events declare coverage, so the containment_coverage_loss trip condition has explicit data rather than silence (spec 13.2).
